sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Soumen Ray’s contributor biography identifies him as Soumen Roy, the author of the novel Scar and the poetry collection Lyrical Musings. Both titles were reviewed by Literoma in January 2023. Bookseller catalogues list Lyrical Musings under the Roy spelling, with a 2022 Notion Press edition.

His brief Kabita Live poem “DUSK AND DAWN” places contrasting moods within the changing light of a single landscape. Laughter and weariness give way to grey and crimson images of hurt. Repeated sounds and the return to dusk and dawn bind these abrupt emotional shifts into a small, unsettled cycle.
